title: Orbit Channel Features
description: Channel capability declarations. Omit features or use {} for standard subscription (persist + refresh + limit 100).

persist.description: Whether list results are stored in the database

refresh.description: Whether the channel is included in refreshInterval scheduling

limit.description: Max items retained per channel in DB; oldest records are pruned when exceeded

style.description: offset: page numbers; cursor: opaque token; lastId: last item id

idFrom.description: For lastId style: field to read id from when loading more

carryParams.description: Extra param keys taken from fetch next and merged on load-more (e.g. seenIds for deduplicated recommendation feeds)

persist.description: true: write fetched content back to DB; false: display only

chaptersFeature.description: Intermediate sub-list between feed and detail (manga episodes, TV episodes, novel chapters, etc.). Mutually exclusive with top-level detail.

route.description: Route to fetch chapter/episode list for a parent feed item

idParam.description: Parent item id key in params (e.g. manga/series id)

idFrom.description: Field on feed item to read parent id

label.description: UI label for the sub-list page (e.g. 话数, 集数, 章节)

itemLabel.description: Single item suffix in UI (e.g. 话, 集, 章)

persist.description: Whether chapter list is cached per parent item

limit.description: Max chapters retained per parent item when persist is true

chapterDetailFeature.description: Final content fetch when user opens a chapter/episode item

idFrom.description: Field on chapter item to read chapter id

parentParam.description: Parent feed item id key passed alongside chapter id

parentFrom.description: Source of parent id in chapters context

persist.description: true: write content to chapter record; false: display only (typical for manga images)
